messages:
nina: Hey folks 1; casual couch co-op tonight? Thinking local co-op + some Steam party games. 8pm in the rec room. Bring controllers and small change for pizza.
omar: Im in if there's Mario Kart or Helldivers. Also I can bring my Steam Deck dock and a couple USB-C hubs.
casey: Ill come by with two Switch controllers and a USB-C power bank. What about netplay for Jackbox? Need a phone for voting.
yuri: Count me in. I can host a Jackbox room and bring my laptop. Also happy to run quick tourney brackets for anything 1v1.
ops-bot: Room booking confirmed: Rec Room B, 8:00-11:30pm. Please follow safe power policy.
nina: Sweet. @omar could you bring an ethernet cable? We might want a wired stream for stable capture.
omar: Yup I have a 15ft cat6. Also Ill pick up one large margherita and one garlic pizza. Any dietary requests?
casey: Gluten-free slice pls if possible, otherwise salad for me.
yuri: No garlic for me (bad breath warning). :grimacing: Also, bring name stickers so controllers don't vanish.
ina: Good call. Quick poll: competitive or chill? React with :trophy: for competitive, :coffee: for chill.
casey: :coffee:
yuri: :trophy:
omar: :trophy:
nina: Leaning chill but we can run a couple competitive exhibition matches after 10.
ops-bot: Reminder will post 30 minutes before start.
casey: Also FYI the office HDMI adapter loaners are by the front desk if anyone forgets one.
yuri: If anyone wants to stream, I can handle OBS and overlays. Need someone to shoutcast (narrate).
omar: I can do commentary if needed, will bring silly puns.
nina: Amazing. See you at 8. Ping here if delayed. :raised_hands:
